turns.text: It was hard at first, but the difference wasn't just like an app or getting onto Instagram accidentally.
turns.zh: 一开始挺难的，但差别不只是像某个应用或者不小心点进Instagram那样。

turns.text: It was the boundary I set for myself.
So, I made that rule, and I stuck to it.
turns.zh: 所以，我定了那条规矩，然后我就坚持下来了。
这就是我为什么真的成功了。

turns.text: So, while there are definitely some psychological tricks involved, I'd still argue that in most cases it comes down to self-control.
turns.zh: 所以，虽然肯定有一些心理技巧在里头，但我还是觉得大多数情况下这归结于自控力。

turns.text: Do you pick up your phone or not, right?
turns.zh: 你是拿起手机还是不拿，对吧？

turns.text: And are we willing to build better habits when we notice there's a problem?
turns.zh: 还有，当我们注意到有问题时，我们愿不愿意去建立更好的习惯？
